instruction: Triage this batch of customer support emails: assign each email to exactly one support category by its primary intent.

emails.subject: Access after role change
emails.body: Since you changed my role I can't see the billing section anymore. Pages load fine for my colleagues, so nothing is down — I just need my permissions put back so I can reach billing.

emails.subject: Still charged for removed seats
emails.body: We removed three seats last month and the app reflects it correctly. The problem is only this invoice: it still bills the old seat count. Please correct the charge.

emails.subject: Export: broken or intended?
emails.body: When we export a large report to CSV it fails every time with an error. Is that expected behaviour, or is it broken? For us it never completes — it just errors out.

emails.subject: Wrong SKU sent
emails.body: You shipped the wrong unit. I'd like the correct one sent out; once it arrives we can reconcile the price difference, but the priority is getting the right item delivered.

emails.subject: Totals look wrong
emails.body: Our weekly totals look wrong, so at first we thought it was a bug. After checking, the numbers are actually correct — we just don't understand how your 'week' is defined. Can you explain how the weekly rollup works?

provenance.source_benchmark: CRMArena-Pro Case Routing / Activity Priority Understanding (Huang et al., 2025)
provenance.construction_method: Batch-triage task (single input batch -> single labelled output, Section 2.2.3). Difficulty = batch size (3/5/8) x per-email ambiguity; Med/High emails carry competing near-duplicate signals with one primary intent; High emails are verbose with a buried core ask to load the context. Author-constructed from a labelled pool; no benchmark text reproduced.
